notes.title: Plunder Masters' July Developments
notes.content:
As a solo dev, I am thrilled to share with you what I've been up to over the past month! I kept of coding, testing, and tweaking, but I'm happy to say that I've made some substantial progress.

First and foremost, I've introduced a new feature that allows players to neutralize enemies in their path! It's a tactical addition that enhances your strategic options when planning your heists.

Next, I've enhanced the game's AI to recognize and respond to dead bodies, adding a layer of complexity and realism. This ties in with another major addition - CCTV cameras. These security measures further up the stakes and will definitely keep you on your toes!

In the background, I've been working tirelessly on setting up everything for the upcoming demo. It's getting closer every day, and I can't wait to share it with you.

Besides these major updates, I've been performing a multitude of minor fixes to improve the overall quality of the game. It's all about making sure the player experience is as smooth and enjoyable as possible.

Stay tuned for more updates on the game. Don't forget to wishlist Plunder Masters on Steam if you haven't already. Your support means the world to me!

Cheers!
Federico Figone

notes.title: May work in progress updates!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, GAMERS![/h2]

As a solo developer, the journey of creating this game has been both challenging and exciting. I've poured my heart and soul into this project and am thrilled to share the progress I've made over the past month:

[h1]What have I been working on?[/h1]

[h3]Wall & Roof Dissolve Shader:[/h3] 
I've added a new feature that allows the walls and roofs of buildings to dissolve, making it easier for you to strategize your next move from a better vantage point, but most importantly, it lets you be able to better play the game without walls interfering with your view!

[h3]Character Interactions:[/h3]
I've been working on ways to make your team of thieves more dynamic and have enabled them to interact with NPCs and each other.

[h3]UI Improvements:[/h3] 
To make the game more accessible, I've made changes to the user interface. Now you'll be able to use commands instead of relying on keyboard shortcuts.

[h3]Randomized Generation:[/h3] 
To keep the gameplay engaging, I've added randomized generation. This means each heist you undertake will present a unique challenge.

[h3]Tutorial Redesign:[/h3]
I've also been working on revamping the tutorial to help newcomers get the hang of the game mechanics more efficiently.

Your support and feedback have been incredibly valuable. Remember, Plunder Masters is still in development, so your early interest and suggestions can really shape the future of the game.

If you haven't done so already, consider adding Plunder Masters to your Steam wishlist to stay updated on future developments, this would also help me A LOT!

I can't wait to share more with you!

Thank you,
Federico

notes.title: Plunder Masters Announcement~
notes.content:
Greetings, future master thieves! 👋

We're incredibly excited to share with you our upcoming game, Plunder Masters. Crafted with a deep passion for real-time strategy (RTS) and a love for all things larcenous, this game puts you in the role of a mastermind thief assembling and commanding a unique team of burglars and plunderers.

Plunder Masters is a single-player RTS set in a vibrant, interactive world. As the leader of a daring group of thieves, your objective is to plan and execute high-stakes heists, making the best use of your team's diverse abilities to outsmart security systems and guards, and escape with your spoils.

Develop your team, equip them with unique skills, and take on challenging missions. The world is rich with opportunities for those cunning enough to seize them. Your strategic decisions and interactions with the environment will provide the advantage you need to pull off the perfect heist undetected.

The game is still under development and we have a lot in store for you in the coming months! Check back here regularly for updates, behind-the-scenes glimpses, and other exciting news from the development process.

To support us, make sure to wishlist Plunder Masters on Steam, and don't forget to follow our social media channels for more updates and insights. Your enthusiasm and support mean the world to us!

Stay tuned, master thieves. The world is yours for the taking. Let's get ready to plunder!
